title: The Calling
summary: A god's voice pulled you from the void and cast you into Vassnian as its Godsent.

god_1.text: Darkness. Then light -- blinding, searing, absolute. A voice echoes from everywhere and nowhere.

god_2.text: "You are not from this world. Your soul was... untethered. Drifting between realms. I caught it before it dissolved into nothing."
god_2.speaker: The Voice

god_3.text: "I am what remains of a forgotten god. And you... you are my last gamble. This world is dying, Godsent. I'm sending you into it -- not as a savior, but as a survivor. Prove me right."
god_3.speaker: The Voice

choices.text: "Tell me what I need to do."

god_end.text: The light collapses inward. You feel yourself falling -- not through air, but through something heavier. When your eyes open again, you are somewhere else entirely.
